selection: First declared sample case for each named project/error type; six FP and six FN across 12 projects

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Three mock.patch-injected arguments are flagged as unresolved fixture candidates; self.assertTrue is not an ast.Assert. v2 adds assertion-like call counts; injection resolution remains a documented gap.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: x/y/z are supplied by @given rather than pytest fixtures. Unresolved candidate counts overstate actual fixture gaps; neither flags nor outcome fields are predictors.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Ordinary mapping assertions with resolved local fixtures still receive high risk. Source patterns alone do not prove an inconsistent outcome.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: A one-line color conversion test inherits color-environment fixture context. Generic aggregate context can dominate a simple body; v2 separates context kinds.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Test builds code strings and invokes a Python subprocess. Strings are deliberately masked in text features; generated program semantics remain outside AST extraction.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: datetime.date constructs fixed dates; a time-token lexical count cannot distinguish deterministic date handling from dependence on current time.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Source contains multiprocessing events, timed waits and process joins. v2 adds blocking/cleanup operation counts; the excerpt does not establish the causal reason for the observed failure.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Unittest assertion methods, mutation of kwargs and mock HTTP class dispatch are visible. v2 adds assertion/mutation counts; runtime method dispatch stays unresolved. Long function reviewed by excerpt.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Test checks sys.modules and late imports under freeze_time. Module-level/re-export behavior is a plausible missing context dimension, not a verified cause. Long function reviewed by excerpt.

reviews.review: AI-assisted source excerpt and identity inspected; no execution or causal validation
reviews.finding: Many parameterized cases share one body. Literal parameter values are absent from predictors, so case-specific behavior is not fully represented.
